To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a) there is a vibrant community music sector in the Green Triangle; b) it is characterised by a diversity of music genres; c) it is sustained by a range of factors, including a strong leadership presence, careful management of membership, a canny pragmatisim, a strong networking presence, and the association of localities with particular music genres; d) it is sustained despite the presence of a number of challenges to the sustainability of the region as a whole; and e)

the sustainability of a community music domain in the Green Triangle cross-border region is sustained by a combination of the pragmatism of its leaders, the networking of its participants and the distinctive character of the music of its localities.

the community music sector in the Green Triangle region, encompassing the cities of Portland and Hamilton in south western Victoria and Mount Gambier in south eastern South Australia is vibrant, resilient, adaptable and sustainable.
